title: Getting to the City Centre
text:
Maria wants to go to the city centre. First, she looks at the bus map. Bus number 5 goes to the centre every ten minutes. The bus stop is near her house.

On Saturday the timetable changes. Bus number 5 leaves at eight o'clock and then every twenty minutes. Maria checks the timetable before she leaves home.

questions.text: How often does bus number 5 go to the centre?
What time does bus number 5 leave on Saturday?
Why does Maria look at the map first?
options: To plan how to get to the centre
To buy a new bus ticket

questions.text: What is probably true about bus number 5 on Saturday?
options: It runs less often than on weekdays
It does not run at all
It only goes to the airport

vocabulary.definition: a drawing that shows the streets and places in an area
a list that shows when buses or trains leave and arrive
the middle part of a town where most shops and offices are
a place where a bus stops so that people can get on or off

paragraph_translations: María quiere ir al centro de la ciudad. Primero, mira el mapa de autobuses. El autobús número 5 va al centro cada diez minutos. La parada del autobús está cerca de su casa.
El sábado el horario cambia. El autobús número 5 sale a las ocho y después cada veinte minutos. María revisa el horario antes de salir de casa.
